name: Cone of Cold, Lesser
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level magus 3, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 4

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.

This spell functions as cone of cold except the cone is smaller and the damage is capped at 10d6 cold damage.
